limitations: The sample-path and no-execution instructions are treated as request-specific rather than durable.

activation_conditions: When preparing a Quartz synchronization plan

claims.statement: Before presenting any synchronization command, show the exact source and destination and state whether overwriting can occur.

activation_conditions: When describing a read-only dry run for a disposable generated Quartz preview

claims.statement: A backup may be omitted only for a read-only dry run of a disposable generated Quartz preview; both source and destination paths must still be shown.
